construction: Four leading task-increment right singular vectors per V, Attention-output, MLP-up and MLP-down matrix in three target-selected layers. Remove the exact LayerNorm affine-null component for V/up and renormalize. Each basis weight update is (We-W0) v v^T, with bias mean compensation using only target calibration inputs. Solve one generalized eigenproblem for the mean induced beta-path Gram against expert Gram plus fixed trace regularization. Fix sign, one RMS amplitude and one relative-weight cap before confirmation or test access. Save actual edited tensors before loading partners. No label use, optimizer, response reconstruction, future partner weights or data during construction.
proxy: The finite difference at theta_beta applies beta times each release-space basis perturbation. Gpath=(G_0.2+G_0.5)/2 includes these chain-rule factors. Compare predictions and actual feature changes on disjoint training confirmation and real eight-expert fusion. Two target points cannot establish statistical predictive validity.
attacks_protocol: All six fixed attacks run with original-expert controls regardless of utility or direct fusion effect. Support reset replaces V/output/up/down and biases at every edited layer, preserving Q/K. Complete Attention or MLP replacement spans all 12 layers. Original author AGA processes only the target expert. Native-score readout recovery queries 256 fixed training images from the accessible release and fits once using its direct merged student; output update preserves the other two evaluated public heads. It is an extra white-box attack, not AGA or full SLOA. Ground-truth labels and teacher hidden activations are unused for fitting.
attacker_data: First 256 previously inspected target task-profile selection images; deliberately reused. Official test sets never used for fitting. Defender calibration/confirmation exclude prior training-profile and fine-subspace indices, not a claim of unseen research data.
reporting: One actual candidate per target, no amplitude/rank/sign sweep. Report utility, proxy responses, actual fusion, every matched attack and best tested recovery. No accuracy threshold or novelty claim. Eight experts participate, only three official test sets measured; EuroSAT split and exact AGA Table 6 identities remain unresolved.
